defs.def: thin, in a way that is attractive 人

ex.s: If he can eat much and keep slim, why can’t I?
ex.t: 如果他能吃很多还保持苗条，为什么我不能呢？

ex.s: How slim we want to be.

To be sure, more than half of teens still engage in these activities, but the ___44___ have slimmed considerably, Between 1976 and 1979, 86 percent of high school seniors had gone on a date; between 2010 and 2015 only 63 percent People say, Oh, it's because teenagers are more responsible, or more lazy, or more boring, “but they're ___45___ the larger trend,” said Jean Twenge, lead author of the study, which drew on seven large time-lag surveys of Americans.
ex.t: 根据一种进化心理学理论，一个人的"生命策略"会根据其环境而减缓或加速，暴露于"严酷和不可预测"的环境会导致更快的发展，而资源丰富和安全的环境会产生相反的效果，研究说。

ex.s: She still has smooth skin and straight black hair, and jogging has kept her slim and fit.
ex.t: 她的皮肤仍然光滑，头发依然乌黑直顺，慢跑让她保持了苗条和健康。

ex.s: So, ever since I discovered selfie apps that could remove my freckles, enlarge my eyes and even slim my jawline, I have become addicted.
ex.t: 所以，自从我发现那些能去除我的雀斑、放大我的眼睛、甚至让我的下巴变尖的自拍应用后，我就上瘾了。

ex.s: I see what you mean, but … GOING POSITIVE I always wanted to look like the slim girls on TV even though I knew that it was impossible.
ex.t: 我明白你的意思，但是……积极面对 我一直想看起来像电视上那些苗条的女孩，尽管我知道那是不可能的。

ex.s: Indeed, his slim but strong body was just like that of millions of Chinese farmers, to whom he had devoted his life.
ex.t: 没错，他那瘦削而结实的身躯，就像千百万中国农民一样，他把自己的一生都奉献给了他们。

ex.s: Because of the weather and very little knowledge of how to survive in the Antarctic, the chances of success were quite slim and many explorers died.
ex.t: 由于天气恶劣，且对如何在南极生存知之甚少，成功的机会相当渺茫，许多探险家都死去了。

defs.def: not as big as you would like or expect 微薄的；不足的；少的；小的
